links.outcome: Readability (WSTF, FRE) of LLM-simplified German patient education texts versus originals and eighth-grade target
links.effect: Original WSTF 11.24, FRE 35.92. Copilot WSTF 8.99, GPT-3.5 9.96, GPT-4o 10.6 (significant improvement); Le Chat 11.71 (no improvement). No model significantly reached eighth-grade level.
links.quote: ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-40, and Microsoft Copilot showed a statistically significant improvement in readability. However, the t tests yielded no statistically significant results for the reduction of scores lower than the eighth grade level.

links.outcome: Reading level of original German online patient education materials
links.effect: Original texts averaged WSTF 11.24 (SD 1.29) and FRE 35.92 (SD 7.64), rated difficult to quite difficult, above the recommended eighth-grade level.
links.quote: Most of the original texts were rated as difficult to quite difficult (average WSTF 11.24, SD 1.29; FRE 35.92, SD 7.64).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT, Copilot, Le Chat) on their ability to simplify German patient education materials using automated readability metrics, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
